selectionGuide.description: A two-panel sequence shows a man shooting Hannibal and then asking who killed him, pairing obvious responsibility with denial.
bestFor: a perpetrator blaming others for a problem they directly caused
an institution creating a failure and then feigning confusion
calling out denial when responsibility is already visible
avoidWhen: violent imagery would be inappropriate for the subject or audience
the explanation requires more than a direct cause and denial

mechanics.visual: The first panel establishes responsibility through the shooting; the second panel makes the same character's denial visibly absurd.
mechanics.text: Use setup to identify the actor or harmful action, then make question voice that actor's attempt to blame an outside target.
